8.text: 🇷🇺 Video of grandfather's wartime heroism inspires marine to join special military operation A video depicting the heroic actions of a grandfather during wartime motivated a Russian marine to enlist in the special military operation. The footage, shared widely online, highlighted personal sacrifice and patriotism. The marine cited the video as a key factor in his decision to serve. Source: RIA Novosti

9.text: 🔥 Russian strikes hit dual-use warehouse and energy infrastructure in Ukraine Russia's Armed Forces continue carrying out group strikes on logistics centers, port and energy infrastructure of Ukraine used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Among the targets hit were a warehouse storing dual-use goods and energy facilities. • Targets included logistics centers, port and energy infrastructure • A warehouse storing dual-use goods was struck • Strikes continue as part of ongoing group operations Source: TASS

5.text: ⚠️ Nearly 80 Ukrainian drones destroyed over Bryansk region in 24 hours Russia's defense ministry reported that almost 80 Ukrainian drones were destroyed over Bryansk region during a 24-hour period. No further details were provided about damage or casualties on the ground. Source: RIA Novosti

12.text: 🏛️ FT lists possible reasons China blocked G20 communique The Financial Times has outlined possible reasons why China blocked the G20 communique. Details of the reported reasons were not provided in the source. Source: RIA Novosti

13.text: ⚖️ Russia's Supreme Court protects 89-year-old pensioner who lost only home Russia's Supreme Court has ruled in defense of an 89-year-old pensioner who was deprived of his only housing. The ruling overturns prior decisions that had left the elderly man without a home. Source: RIA Novosti

14.text: 🚗 Cold water floods roadway in northern Saint Petersburg A roadway in the north of Saint Petersburg was flooded with cold water, local authorities reported. Specialists are already working to address the aftermath of the incident. • Location is in the northern part of Saint Petersburg • Repair crews are on site Source: TASS

15.text: 🧑‍⚖️ Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides annually, study finds A new study estimates 402–433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning among farmers and farm workers each year. Pesticide poisoning kills around 11,000 people annually, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities, according to data from 2006–2023. • Study commissioned by Pesticide Action Network • 11,000 deaths per year linked to pesticide poisoning Source: The Guardian

16.text: 💰 VEB.RF backed four investment projects worth 130 billion rubles Kerefov announced that VEB.RF has supported four investment projects totaling 130 billion rubles. The statement was reported by Vedomosti. No further details on the specific projects were provided. Source: Vedomosti

17.text: 🌐 Israeli forces and settlers attack two West Bank mosques Israeli forces fired tear gas into one mosque in the West Bank after settlers set fire to and vandalised another. The separate incidents reflect ongoing tensions between settlers and Palestinian residents in the occupied territory. • Settlers set fire to and vandalised one mosque • Israeli forces fired tear gas into another mosque • Both incidents occurred in the West Bank Source: Al Jazeera

18.text: 🔥 Iran strikes US bases in Middle East after reports of US attack on wedding party Iran has attacked US bases in the Middle East following reports that a US strike killed five people at a wedding party. The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and never targets civilians. • Iranian Red Crescent says a child was killed by shrapnel from a US strike on a home • Reports say a US strike killed five people at a wedding party • US military says it is aware of the reports and never targets civilians Source: BBC
